containers.title: Group by — pick a key; bars stack to the true total either way

config.sqlTemplate: SELECT $__timeInterval(minute_start) AS ts, platform AS group_key, round(sum(active_ms) / ($__interval_s * 1000.0), 2) AS avg_concurrent FROM __DATABASE__.serving_minute_current WHERE dim_mask = 63 AND ($__timeFilter(minute_start) AND minute_start < $__toTime) AND $__filters GROUP BY ts, group_key ORDER BY ts

SELECT platform AS group_key, round(sum(active_ms) / 3600000.0, 2) AS viewer_hours, round(100.0 * sum(active_ms) / nullIf((SELECT sum(active_ms) FROM __DATABASE__.serving_minute_current WHERE dim_mask = 63 AND ($__timeFilter(minute_start) AND minute_start < $__toTime) AND $__filters), 0), 2) AS share_pct, sum(sessions_started) AS intervals_started FROM __DATABASE__.serving_minute_current WHERE dim_mask = 63 AND ($__timeFilter(minute_start) AND minute_start < $__toTime) AND $__filters GROUP BY group_key ORDER BY viewer_hours DESC

tiles.name: Average concurrent viewers by title (top 10, rest folded into 'other')

config.sqlTemplate: SELECT $__timeInterval(minute_start) AS ts, if(content_id IN (SELECT content_id FROM __DATABASE__.serving_minute_current WHERE dim_mask = 63 AND ($__timeFilter(minute_start) AND minute_start < $__toTime) AND $__filters GROUP BY content_id ORDER BY sum(active_ms) DESC LIMIT 10), title, 'other') AS group_key, round(sum(active_ms) / ($__interval_s * 1000.0), 2) AS avg_concurrent FROM __DATABASE__.serving_minute_current WHERE dim_mask = 63 AND ($__timeFilter(minute_start) AND minute_start < $__toTime) AND $__filters GROUP BY ts, group_key ORDER BY ts

SELECT title AS group_key, video_type, category, round(sum(active_ms) / 3600000.0, 2) AS viewer_hours, round(100.0 * sum(active_ms) / nullIf((SELECT sum(active_ms) FROM __DATABASE__.serving_minute_current WHERE dim_mask = 63 AND ($__timeFilter(minute_start) AND minute_start < $__toTime) AND $__filters), 0), 2) AS share_pct, sum(sessions_started) AS intervals_started FROM __DATABASE__.serving_minute_current WHERE dim_mask = 63 AND ($__timeFilter(minute_start) AND minute_start < $__toTime) AND $__filters AND title != '' GROUP BY group_key, video_type, category ORDER BY viewer_hours DESC LIMIT 30

tiles.name: Why these bars can be stacked

config.markdown:
### Pick the group-by key from the tab bar

Every tab reads the same rows — `serving_concurrency_minute` at `dim_mask = 63`, the full-grain slice — and only changes what it groups by. That is what lets the filters at the top compose with any grouping: filter to `Content type = live` and switch to the Platform tab, and you get live viewing broken down by platform, still exact.

### Stacking is only honest because of the metric

The bars plot `sum(active_ms) / bucket_length` — the **time-weighted average concurrent viewers** in each bucket. `active_ms` is session-milliseconds, which is additive across every dimension and across time, so a stack of per-platform bars sums to exactly the true overall average for that bucket. Nothing is double counted and nothing is lost; the `other` bucket on the Title and Category tabs exists so the stack total stays exact rather than silently dropping the long tail.

**A peak could not be stacked.** Two platforms reach their maximum at different instants, so stacked peaks would total more viewers than were ever simultaneously present — on the tuning extract, per-platform peaks sum well above the true 2,305. That is why there is no peak on this dashboard: exact peaks are precomputed per grouping and live on *SonyLIV — Concurrency analytics*, in a group explicitly marked as not filterable. If you want to compare peaks across a dimension, use that dashboard's bar and table tiles, which read the mask that was computed at that grouping.

`share_pct` in each table is a share of viewing **time**, not of viewers, for the same reason — time is what adds up.

Published on the same lag as the minute layer, so every number here has had the late-arrival window close before it was shown. Policy `sonyliv-active-v1`, 120s liveness lease, half-open `[start, end)` in UTC.
